name: Statut
tagline: Regulatory infrastructure for multi-state cannabis operators.
positioning: Statut reconciles METRC, license renewals, and transport manifests into a single audit-ready record across every jurisdiction you operate in.

hero.h1: Compliance infrastructure for multi-state cannabis operators
hero.sub: Statut reconciles METRC inventory, license renewals, and transport manifests into one continuous audit trail — so a state inspection is a report you export, not a fire drill.

features.title: METRC reconciliation
features.description: Match every package tag, adjustment, and transfer against your seed-to-sale system nightly. Discrepancies surface before a regulator ever files them.

features.title: License lifecycle tracking
features.description: Track renewal windows, conditional-use permits, and local endorsements across every facility. Statut escalates 90, 60, and 30 days out — per license.

features.title: Manifest & chain of custody
features.description: Reconstruct any transport manifest with GPS, driver, and timestamp records intact. Chain of custody stays intact from cultivation to retail shelf.

features.title: Multi-state rule engine
features.description: Encoded regulations for 24 active markets. When a state amends packaging or potency limits, your workflows update — with a versioned changelog.

features.title: Audit-ready evidence room
features.description: Every record is immutable, timestamped, and exportable to a regulator-formatted packet in under a minute. No screenshots. No spreadsheets.

features.title: Deviation alerting
features.description: Real-time alerts for inventory drift, expired tags, and out-of-window destructions, routed to the compliance officer of record by facility.

testimonials.quote: We operate in nine states with nine different rulebooks. Statut is the first system that reconciled all of them without a spreadsheet army. Our last audit closed in three days.
testimonials.name: Danielle Ferraro

testimonials.quote: The manifest reconstruction alone justified the contract. When our carrier was flagged, we produced a complete chain of custody in eleven minutes.
testimonials.name: Marcus Okafor

testimonials.quote: Statut caught a 400-unit METRC discrepancy three weeks before our state inspection. That single catch is why I renewed at the enterprise tier.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar
